Improve benchmark lifecycle and result history (#19)

## Summary

* Correct Restore, Reuse, and Renew behavior across the benchmark
handlers.
* Normalize request inputs and improve peak-memory sampling.
* Version benchmark definitions and preserve selectable result
histories.
* Clarify runtime lifecycle details and request-time code-selection
limitations.
* Improve dashboard comparison, labeling, tables, and responsive
styling.

Signed-off-by: Ludvig Liljenberg <4257730+ludfjig@users.noreply.github.com>
